name: Documentary photo
means: A photograph taken of something that was happening anyway: available light with no fill, framing that is slightly off, subject caught mid-gesture, and a background nobody tidied.
prose: a documentary photograph, available light only with no fill, handheld 35mm lens, slightly off-centre framing, unposed subject caught mid-gesture and not looking at the camera, cluttered real background, mixed colour temperature between cold window light and warm overhead bulbs
negative_add: studio lighting, posed, retouched, symmetrical composition, stock photo, illustration, anime
works_for: video reasonably well - it is already a handheld idiom, so LTX drift reads as camera operation rather than as failure. Inferred from the idiom, not measured.
note: Fails by being too good. Qwen's default is a well-lit, well-composed, retouched photograph and the word 'documentary' does not undo that - you have to spend words on the specific imperfections: no fill, mixed colour temperature, background clutter, subject not looking at the camera. It overlaps war_photography heavily and the honest separation between them is the grade more than the prompt. No anime form: the entire premise is that a camera made it, and on Animagine that premise is in the standing negative. | Downgraded to untested: NOTHING in this library was rendered when it was authored, so every strength and engine call is a considered prediction. This project's own standard - written on the Illustrious checkpoint card - is that a recommendation is not a measurement.
verified_by: Looked at, against the no-style control at the same seed with the same subject. studio/_tools/style_examples.py
